q: Which surface moves human review to the pull request?
explain: Cloud agents work remotely and return pull requests.

q: What is the best way to choose between coding agents?
options: Run candidates on a handful of real tasks from your own repository and read the transcripts
explain: Your code and conventions decide what works.

q: Why keep one source of truth for agent instructions?
options: Different rules files for different agents produce inconsistent code
explain: Point CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md and rules files at one AGENTS.md or shared doc.
